capabilities: Push notes to CloudBrain with incremental hashing and per-note updates
Upload documents (PDF, Office, images, EPUB and more) from chosen folders
Read text in images and scanned PDFs via server-side OCR
Exclude files with glob patterns and dashboard rules before upload
Query the vault through a chat on WhatsApp, Telegram or the web
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a two-way sync: it only pushes copies to CloudBrain and never writes back into the vault.
extras: The settings interface is in Italian. It is a paid service with a free trial. The server rejects files that look like credentials; the plugin claims no telemetry. Documents sync is off by default and limited to 25 MB on mobile data.
problem: Notes stored locally in Obsidian cannot be searched or answered from messaging apps or the web; this sends copies to a service that offers chat-based retrieval.

relations.evidence: The plugin sends the content of your Markdown notes to the CloudBrain server you configure

requires.name: CloudBrain paid service with free trial

summary: One-way sync plugin that pushes Markdown notes and optional documents to CloudBrain, making the vault searchable via WhatsApp, Telegram and web chat with citations.
